amendment_reason: Shift the fixed 512 global polar angles by half a bin to avoid deterministic polygon-vertex and axis-aligned-edge coincidences introduced by maximum-R contour canonicalization. Keep the same ray count, centroid, intersection/dedup tolerances and strict all-or-none star-shaped gate; no measurement or score prompted the shift.

cost_and_next_gate.estimated_CPU_wall: The already frozen first100/300 scorer-contour extraction took about 6 seconds at four workers. The exact 512-half-bin-ray by 512-segment batched intersection check adds about 78.6 million pair tests; budget under two minutes CPU and below 2 GB incremental memory, then report actual wall. No GPU or full-corpus read.
cost_and_next_gate.if_passes: Only after root reviews this one-sample result, separately preregister a single center-plus-log-radius PCA64 family: fit the first100 TRAIN true contours and check a THIRD disjoint100 compact-TRAIN shot triplets, with fixed 32/64 component gates median<=0.25 and p95<=0.5 grid cell, zero out-of-grid/self-crossing. Do not use the earlier second100 to claim a new gate pass.

geometry.inside: Use the frozen scorer's even-odd point-in-polygon helper to test each centroid and require its minimum physical distance to all 512 straight polygon segments to exceed tau. An outside or on-boundary centroid is a frame-level star-shaped failure, not a reason to substitute the magnetic axis or skip the frame.
geometry.numerical_rule: The ray is unit length. Classify |cross(ray_direction,segment)| <= 1e-12*segment_length as parallel; if also collinear within the same physical tau, report ambiguous rather than inventing one crossing. For nonparallel segments accept 0<=segment_parameter<=1 with endpoint roundoff tolerance tau/segment_length and ray_radius>tau. Record all tolerance-triggered, duplicate and ambiguous cases by shot/frame/angle.
geometry.origin: Use each true contour's signed shoelace polygon centroid in physical metres after canonical CCW orientation. This is a TRAIN-target construction only. A future deployable model would predict the center from permitted inputs; no true centroid may be an inference feature.
geometry.per_frame_readout: Record scorer polygon centroid, origin-inside flag, minimum positive ray radius, count of angles with exactly one unique positive intersection, zero/multiple/ambiguous counts, and the first pathological shot/frame/angle. Preserve all 300 frame rows in ignored frozen run evidence and a small tracked summary.
geometry.rays: For j=0..511, fix theta_j=2*pi*(j+0.5)/512 from the positive R direction and ray c+t*(cos(theta_j),sin(theta_j)), t>0. Intersect against all 512 straight physical polygon segments with the 2-D cross-product line equations. Treat a collinear nonzero-length segment as ambiguous failure. Retain positive ray parameters and segment parameters within the predeclared physical tolerance; deduplicate adjacent shared-vertex hits whose positive radii differ by at most tau=0.0001*minimum physical grid spacing. Do not merge farther distinct crossings.
geometry.true_contour: Extract the same frozen scorer-native 512-point physical (R,Z) LCFS from efit_psirz on the 300 fixed TRAIN frames. Use no stored efit_lcfs_* boundary, external archive, original base prediction or scored-tail label. Verify finite, simple, nondegenerate polygons and exact DIII-D scorer grid/mask, failing with shot/frame context otherwise.
geometry.viability_gate: Pass only if all 300 true-contour centroids are strictly inside, every one of the 153,600 fixed rays has exactly one unique positive intersection and no collinear ambiguity occurs. Otherwise stop before log-radius PCA or any direct model fit. This strict topology gate is not a competition S result and does not prove center/radius predictability.

name: train-only-scorer-LCFS-star-shaped-centroid-gate-v2

prior_evidence.motivation: K16 absolute Fourier lost local separatrix detail; a direct 64-component physical-contour PCA met geometric median/p95 gates on a second TRAIN sample but one polygon self-crossed. Moving that polygon toward its simple PCA mean first removed the crossing only beyond the half-cell geometry threshold. This distinct radial representation tests topology without changing those measured gates.

question: Is every scorer-native diverted LCFS in a fixed TRAIN-only probe sample star-shaped around its own physical polygon centroid, so an input-only center plus positive log-radius model could avoid PCA self-crossings by construction?

sample.shot_selection: Reuse exactly the frozen first 100 compact TRAIN filenames and their three q=0.1/0.5/0.9 fixed indices (300 frames) from the earlier train-only representation gate. Do not select frames by their geometry. All 100 shots were in the original 5,633 train files; neither the 1,338 validation shots nor the 70 reserved evaluation tail are in the sample.
